Method of Attack: Deployed via spear-phishing campaign using Coronavirus-themed document baits disguised as health advisories; malicious documents with embedded macros and RTF files exploiting CVE-2017-0199 Microsoft Office/WordPad remote code execution vulnerability; execution of malicious macros to drop 32-bit or 64-bit payloads
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing emails with malicious Excel and RTF documents
Coronavirus-themed phishing emails impersonating Indian government officials
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious documents camouflaged as health advisories
